title: Normalized Tate coefficient comparison over a field
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring with a normalized HasTateTwist datum: its Kummer coordinate boundary has invertible exceptional adjunct over separated schemes locally of finite type over fields. Let N>0 annihilate Λ, k be any field, and N be invertible on Spec k [def-pc-scheme]. In the ordinary etale module derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the degree-one Tate object is isomorphic to the degree-zero single complex of μ_N tensored from Z/N with Λ, defined in [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]. No arbitrary-base descent or compatibility of the selected isomorphism is asserted.

proof.text: For the zero section s of A1_k, put W=Rs! of the constant complex. The coordinate normalization of the specified datum gives Rs!(T(1)[2]) isomorphic to the unit (the adopted-source nonempty_iso_rightDerivedUpperShriek_affineLineZero). The invertibility, shift and pullback clauses of the datum and the co-projection derivedTensorRightCompRightDerivedUpperShriekIso identify this with W tensor T_k(1)[2]. This is the shifted-twist co-projection argument of lem-pur-immersion-twist; all other identifications are unitors.

Apply the same argument to the concrete roots-of-unity Tate datum. Its normalization is the proved adopted-source hasKummerClass_isNormalized in TateTwist.Normalized, obtained by its affine-line Kummer computation. Thus W tensor C[2] and W tensor T[2] are both the unit. Symmetry gives C[2] tensor W equal to the unit. The composite T[2] -> unit tensor T[2] -> (C[2] tensor W) tensor T[2] -> C[2] tensor (W tensor T[2]) -> C[2] tensor unit -> C[2] identifies the shifted lines, and full faithfulness of shift cancels [2].

Use the concrete TateTwistObjectIsoSingleFunctor. Identify the published finiteEtaleTateLine with scalar extension of the abelian roots-of-unity sheaf by uniqueness of left adjoints: additive maps of Z/N modules are automatically Z/N linear. The proved extendScalarsRootsOfUnityIsoTateTwistSheaf supplies root-level independence for N annihilating Λ and invertible on k. Map this isomorphism through the single functor and compose. All arguments work for a zero coefficient ring as well.
